title: Email: Fw: Don't forget to confirm your story plan ...

content.subject: Fw: Don't forget to confirm your story plan ...

content.text:
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Friday, February 1, 2019 8:48 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Don't forget to confirm your story plan ... 
 
We’ll figure out the feature once we figure out what else you have. You need to come away with a few we’ll-reported stories in hand while you’re down there.

Get Outlook for iOS
 
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Friday, February 1, 2019 8:26 AM
To: Thomas, Christopher
Subject: Re: Don't forget to confirm your story plan ... 
 
Let me know which day next week you have room for a blowout feature on the camp. I think it's a Sunday story, personally.
I don't anticipate the price changing much off the $800 I had budgeted at the beginning.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Thursday, January 31, 2019 7:43:39 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Don't forget to confirm your story plan ... 
 
And send me estimated cost sometime over the next day.
